1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3 Bb4 4.e3 O-O 5.Ne.strategy: Puts the question to the bishop. Capturing on c3 would give up the bishop for a knight that Ne2 can retake, leaving White's pawns intact, so Black has to retreat and White is rid of the pin.

Keeps the bishop and points it at h2 on the diagonal towards White's kingside, instead of trading on c3, where the knight could recapture without doubled pawns. Black stays active and keeps the tension in the centre.
1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3 Bb4 4.e3 O-O 5.Ne.name: Nimzo-Indian Defence: Simagin Variation
